tools.name: create_short_link
tools.description: Create a short link that redirects to targetUrl, or shows a link page (pass page instead of targetUrl). Returns the link, including linkId (use it with the other tools) and shortUrl (share this). Give a slug for a memorable URL, otherwise a random 8-character one is generated. Slugs are unique acros

tools.name: list_short_links
tools.description: List your short links, newest first. Filter by tag and/or groupId. A page can hold fewer than limit items even when more exist: keep calling with cursor = nextCursor until nextCursor is absent.

tools.name: get_short_link
tools.description: Fetch one short link by linkId, including its groupIds and lifetime visitCount.

tools.name: update_short_link
tools.description: Change a short link. Only the fields you pass change; tags, metadata, qrStyle and groupIds are replaced wholesale (pass the full new list; [] clears). Set targetUrl to send visitors somewhere else: the short URL and printed QR codes keep working. Set status "paused" to make the short URL answer 410,

tools.name: preview_link_page
tools.description: Render a link's page as HTML for a simulated visit, without recording anything: the saved page, or a draft (page) to try before saving (pictures given as data URLs are drawn inline; nothing is stored or charged). Returns the visible item ids (items with "when" conditions depend on the visit) and the

tools.name: set_domain_home_page
tools.description: Choose the link that the root (/) of this tenant's custom domain shows: a link page becomes the domain's home page, a redirect link sends / there. Pass linkId null to clear it (/ answers 404 again). Has no effect on the platform domain.

tools.name: delete_short_link
tools.description: Permanently delete a short link and remove it from its groups. Its short URL and any printed QR codes stop working (404) and the slug becomes free for anyone. Prefer update_short_link status "paused" if the link may come back.

tools.name: test_redirect_rules
tools.description: Dry run: which destination would a visit with these properties get from this link's rules? For a link page with no matching rule it returns page.itemIds (the buttons that visit would see) instead of targetUrl. Records no visit. Pass a real userAgent to test device routing, e.g. iPhone: "Mozilla/5.0

tools.name: get_short_link_visits
tools.description: Visit analytics for one link: totals over the window ({visits, qr, direct, bot}; visits = qr + direct, bots such as link-preview crawlers are counted separately and excluded from visits), a zero-filled per-day breakdown (UTC, oldest first), and the most recent individual visits (newest first, with s

tools.name: render_qr_code
tools.description: Render a QR code as a PNG image. Pass linkId to render a short link: the image encodes {shortUrl}?s=qr so scans are counted as qr visits, and the link's qrStyle is the default look. Or pass data to render any text (URL, Wi-Fi config, vCard...) as a static QR code that is not tracked. Returns the ima

tools.name: create_group
tools.description: Create a group to organise short links (e.g. a campaign or a venue). Groups are many-to-many: a link can be in up to 20 groups. Add links with add_links_to_group, or pass groupIds when creating/updating a link.

tools.name: list_groups
tools.description: List your groups (with linkCount), ordered by groupId. Page with cursor = nextCursor.

tools.name: get_group
tools.description: Fetch one group. To see its links use list_short_links with group = groupId.

tools.name: update_group
tools.description: Rename a group or change its description or color. Membership doesn't change here.

tools.name: delete_group
tools.description: Delete a group. Its links are NOT deleted; they just stop being members.

tools.name: add_links_to_group
tools.description: Add up to 25 links to a group in one call. Idempotent: links already in the group are reported in alreadyMembers rather than failing. Fails with not_found if any linkId is unknown (nothing is added).

tools.name: remove_link_from_group
tools.description: Take one link out of a group. The link itself is untouched.

tools.name: get_group_visits
tools.description: Combined visit analytics for a group's current member links: totals {visits, qr, direct, bot} and a zero-filled per-day breakdown (UTC). Links removed from the group no longer count.

tools.name: get_custom_domain
tools.description: Get this tenant's custom (alias) domain and advance its setup as far as DNS allows. Use it to check progress after creating a DNS record. Lifecycle: pending_validation (create the certificate_validation record, and the optional ownership_verification TXT if listed) → provisioning (automatic, seconds

tools.name: set_custom_domain
tools.description: Serve all of this tenant's short links on a domain it controls, e.g. "go.acme.com" → https://go.acme.com/{slug}. Once active, new short URLs and QR codes use it; links keep working on the platform domain too. One domain per tenant: setting a different one replaces (and tears down) the current one. S

tools.name: remove_custom_domain
tools.description: Remove this tenant's custom domain. Short links immediately stop resolving on it (QR codes printed with it break) and new short URLs use the platform domain. The DNS records can be deleted afterwards.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "set_custom_domain" is 1592 chars, far longer than this server's median (210). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

evidence.snippet: Serve all of this tenant's short links on a domain it controls, e.g. "go.acme.com" → https://go.acme.com/{slug}. Once active, new short URLs and QR codes use it…

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "set_custom_domain" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

evidence.snippet: Serve all of this tenant's short links on a domain it controls, e.g. "go.acme.com" → https://go.acme.com/{slug}. Once active, new short URLs and QR codes use it…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: update_short_link, render_qr_code · Private data: test_redirect_rules, get_custom_domain, set_custom_domain, remove_custom_domain · Public sink: create_short_link, update_short_link · Destructive: delete_short_link, test_redirect_rules, render_qr_code, delete_group, remove_link_from_group, remove_custom_domain.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: update_short_link, render_qr_code · Private data: test_redirect_rules, get_custom_domain, set_custom_domain, remove_custom_domain · Public sink: create_short_link, update_short_link · Destructive: delete_short_link, test_redirect_rules, render_qr_code, delete_group, remove_link_from_group, remove_custom_domain

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
